📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: October 4, 2026)

On Sunday, October 4, I was invited to Nora Naguri, where the Nagurizato Festival 2026 was held. I had the opportunity to give remarks and visit the various booths at the event.

I would like to extend my thanks to all those who worked hard to make this event possible.
